title: Depth of the De Morgan transformation
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose every gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. If circuit depth is the maximum number of gates along a path to the output, then the circuit obtained by the De Morgan transformation has depth at most three times the depth of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
